status_effects.explanation: His singular imperviousness to the duchess's fluctuating favor casts him as clear-sighted and stable, though the portrait also carries harsh notes (disdainful, violent), so the elevation is modest and mixed.
Her backward culture and repeated bewilderment or embarrassment before the duchess's wit locally diminish her standing as a discerning judge of intellectual and social matters.

appraisal_events.evidence: Lui seul ne l'avait jamais aimée ; en lui elle avait senti toujours un de ces caractères de fer, indifférent aux caprices qu'elle avait, dédaigneux de sa beauté, violent, d'une volonté à ne plier jamais et sous la seule loi desquels les nerveux savent trouver le calme.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles out the duke as the one person immune to the duchess's shifting judgments, describing him as hard, disdainful, and violent, yet also a steadying, unyielding presence — a mixed portrait distinct from the fawning reactions of the rest of her circle.

appraisal_events.evidence: Cet étonnement était encore accru du fait de la culture infiniment arriérée de la princesse... des horizons qui lui paraissaient inouïs et lui restaient confus... elle était confondue d'entendre la duchesse lui dire en souriant que c'était de simples cruches.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator repeatedly frames the princess as intellectually behind the times and easily mystified by the duchess's paradoxes, left confused and then embarrassed once corrected — a local diminishment of her own judgment distinct from the duchess's storyline.
